WORKING AT PERPACH

What to expect.

We are building a mining business from the ground up. That means every person matters, every role is visible and the work is real.

Current vacancies

There are no publicly approved vacancies at present. When roles open, they will appear here with a clear job description, closing date and transparent selection process. We do not maintain rolling applications.

Recruitment safety

Perpach never charges application fees, requests bank details, passports or sensitive identification at first contact, or asks candidates to transfer money. If you receive such a request claiming to be from Perpach, it is fraudulent.

Workplace standard

Safety, dignity, equal opportunity and clear accountability are expected across all Perpach workplaces. We are building a culture where problems are reported, not hidden, and where every team member returns home safely.

Development & growth

As Perpach grows, so do the opportunities. We prioritise internal development and local talent. Our professionalisation programme includes technical training, leadership development and clear progression pathways.

OUR PEOPLE / THE FOUNDATION
OUR CULTURE

Built on accountability.

Perpach is not a large corporate employer — yet. We are a growing business where individual contribution is visible and valued. The culture we are building prioritises honesty over hierarchy, evidence over opinion, and safety over speed.

We look for people who are comfortable with ambiguity, willing to build systems from scratch, and motivated by the challenge of doing difficult work properly in a demanding environment. If you need polished offices and established processes, we are probably not the right fit — yet. If you want to help build them, we might be exactly right.

ETHIOPIA / WHERE WE WORK
LOCATION

Ethiopia.

Our operations are based in Ethiopia. Working here means engaging with one of Africa's most dynamic and complex business environments. It requires cultural sensitivity, adaptability and genuine respect for local communities and customs.

For the right people, it also offers an extraordinary professional opportunity: the chance to build a mining business from its foundations in one of the world's most geologically prospective regions.
